result.summary: This PR adds six new vectors to script_tests.json covering the SCRIPT_VERIFY_CONST_SCRIPTCODE flag, which previously had no test asserting its specific error codes (OP_CODESEPARATOR and SIG_FINDANDDELETE). It includes cases for OP_CODESEPARATOR in executed and unexecuted branches, and signature-push-in-scriptCode against both CHECKSIG and CHECKMULTISIG, plus two off-flag controls. It is a follow-up to the merged #35664, which did similar work for other error codes.
result.problem: script_tests.json is the harness that pins which error code causes a script to fail, but two errors gated by CONST_SCRIPTCODE were never asserted anywhere in the test suite, including one subtle case (OP_CODESEPARATOR rejected even in an unexecuted IF branch) that had zero coverage of any kind. This leaves a regression in that logic undetected until a much later stage.

resolved_concerns: darosior asked about a test case for CVE-2024-38365-style FindAndDelete bug; author explained CONST_SCRIPTCODE doesn't affect that case and agreed to add a separate test for it, which is out of scope for this PR.

result.card: This PR adds six vectors to script_tests.json to pin the error codes for the SCRIPT_VERIFY_CONST_SCRIPTCODE flag, a follow-up to the merged #35664. Previously no test asserted either error gated behind this flag, including one subtle case, OP_CODESEPARATOR rejected in an unexecuted IF branch, that had zero coverage of any kind before this PR. It received a Concept ACK from darosior, who also asked about coverage for a related FindAndDelete CVE, which the author addressed by explaining it's out of scope and offering a separate follow-up test. The PR is small, self-contained, and ready for review with no open concerns. It depends conceptually on the merged #35664 but has no code dependency blocking it.
